title: Phara Dar and the Ring of Scale
summary: Defeat the other Ring of Scale dragons to expose Phara Dar, then control her protectors.
overview: Defeat the other Ring of Scale dragons to expose Phara Dar, then control her protectors.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Secure the other dragons and reserve add control for the larger final protector waves.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Phara Dar begins protected while any of the five listed dragon templates remain alive.
Once all five are gone, the dragon check removes her protection.
At 80%, 60%, 40% and 20% health, she summons two, three, four and five protectors respectively.
Ten minutes out of combat heals her and removes remaining protectors.

notes: Approval E388. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
